comment: add a ? icon inside the "HI" menu item, that when presed will start a on screen teturial, that will explain all functions of jynx interactivly and beautifuly presented and when the user is done with the teturial the ? icon stays on and when he hovers any jynx field there will be a small bubble explaining what it is and functionalities until he goes back to hi menu item and clickes on ? to turn it off
actionLog: PR #114: added a "Help mode" toggle (? icon) inside the Hi dropdown — starts a short guided tour of the toolbar's own buttons (reusing each button's existing title text, no new copy authored), then settles into a persistent hover-bubble mode until toggled off again from the same menu. No live/Playwright verification possible in this environment (no working dev-mode login, and Playwright's browser download is blocked by this sandbox's network allowlist) — build-verified only; flagged in the PR for a manual click-test before merging. UPDATE 2026-09-02: a third independent implementation of this same request landed as PR #115 (spotlight-style tour + hover-bubble restricted to .jynx-chrome elements, plus 2 real bugs found and fixed via live Playwright verification that #114 could not run) — genuinely different, not a shallow duplicate, so not closing either; flagged as a comment on #114 for a human to compare and pick one to merge. FINAL 2026-09-02: a separate PR comment thread on #114 confirmed a third, real bug there — the tour never actually displays (a stale-state race jumps straight to hover-mode on every click) — with a verified fix identified but not applied. Given that unresolved defect plus #115's broader coverage (also spotlights the orientation grip and explains the hold-hotkey comment flow, which #114's tour omits) and its own live end-to-end verification, closed #114 pointing at #115 as canonical rather than leaving two competing PRs open. actionPrUrl switched from #114 to #115.
